meta.title: Email and SMS choices
meta.description: Choose how Friends of Animals sends you messages: by email, by SMS or both.

notificationSettings.title: Email and SMS
notificationSettings.lead: Choose how we send you messages. Every message also appears in your inbox.
notificationSettings.emailNone: Your account has no email address, so email can't reach you.
notificationSettings.smsNoPhone: Your account has no phone number, so SMS can't reach you.
notificationSettings.smsOff: We don't send SMS yet. Until we do, those messages come by email and to your inbox.
notificationSettings.required: Some messages are required by law, such as receipts and safeguarding notices. We send those however you choose here.
notificationSettings.consent: To stop news and updates altogether, withdraw your consent to messages.
